== Biography ==

The King of Hearts presides as judge over the trial of the Knave of Hearts in his royal court. He is notable for his great wig and crown, which he wears together in a manner that appears neither comfortable nor becoming. The King administers his proceedings with grave solemnity and considerable concern for propriety, insisting with great emphasis that all jurymen remain in their proper places before the trial may proceed. His interrogations are marked by methodical persistence; he questions those who appear before him with formal gravity, repeating his lines of inquiry even when the answers prove inconsequential.

== Relationships ==

'''[[Queen]]''' — family. They are seated together upon the throne during the trial proceedings.

'''[[Knave]]''' — employment. The Knave of Hearts carries the King's crown on a crimson velvet cushion, suggesting a service relationship.

'''[[Alice]]''' — acquaintance. The King approaches Alice during the trial and questions her about her knowledge of the case.

'''[[White Rabbit]]''' — employment. The White Rabbit stands near the King with a trumpet and parchment scroll, apparently serving as an official of the court.

'''[[Cheshire Cat]]''' — enemy. The King expresses disapproval of the Cat's appearance yet permits it to kiss his hand, suggesting a complicated relationship marked by distrust and reluctant tolerance.
